mapper.select: SELECT id, username, user_type, enabled, authorization_version FROM iam_user WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_user (id, username, user_type, enabled, authorization_version) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{userType}, #{enabled}, #{authorizationVersion}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE username = VALUES(username), user_type = VALUES(user_type), enabled = VALUES(enabled)
